title: "Overview"

This site contains the rendered analysis documents of my internship project:
snRNA-seq of post-mortem spinal cord (ALS and controls), focused on astrocytes.

## Pipeline

| Script | What it does | Environment |
|--------|--------------|-------------|
| [01 Subsetting astrocytes](scripts/01_subsetting_astros.qmd) | Subsets astrocytes from the full dataset | `r_scrnaseq_core` |

Scripts run in numbered order; each one reads the output of the earlier ones.
See the repository README for setup and reproduction instructions.
